recommendation: permit governance-only commits and synthetic reports; require staged accountable approvals before any source-term, empirical, publication, push, PR, merge, or release promotion

options.recommended: staged local/governance-only promotion with separate gates
options.governance_pr: allow schema/metadata-only PRs with no source terms or payloads
options.full_promotion: defer until licence, ethics, privacy, community, language, validation, freeze, and maintainer approvals close

contingencies.conflict_or_missing_provenance: retain alternatives and quarantine; no majority auto-promotion
contingencies.terms_revoked: quarantine/revert affected artefacts and block release
contingencies.secret_or_payload_incident: stop, purge/rotate under incident procedure, and record receipt

accountability.panel: specialist agents assess candidate quality and provide recommendations only
accountability.push_pr_release: separate explicit maintainer decisions bound to exact commit and hosted validation
